frozen_before: any challenger number was computed; no evaluation code existed when this file was written
question: How much current-season information should replace the pre-season (historical) expectation for a player's opportunity (share of team volume, team volume) versus his per-opportunity efficiency?
evidence_status: DISCOVERY. Every season scored here (2021-2025) and 2026 W1-2 has already been studied by earlier work; none is an untouched holdout. A pass here makes the candidate eligible for deployed SHADOW plus a prospective test on 2026 W3+, never 'validated'.
distinct_from_rejected: The rejected agentB lever (prereg 20615eb2) changed the rolling WINDOW (exponential recency half-life + prior-team row weight) of the incumbent feature builder. This protocol does not reweight a window. It keeps a historical prior (season S-1 only) separate from season-S evidence and combines them by a precision rule whose prior strength k is estimated by method of moments on earlier seasons, per quantity x position x regime, with games as the dependence unit.

data.pbp: pinned fullpipe-20260922 replay-run-54d1ec7 historical_pbp.parquet (2019-2023) + pbp_2024 + pbp_2025 + pbp_2026 (W1-2), REG only
data.rosters: pinned rosters_weekly.parquet (position only; no active/inactive status)
data.proxy_policy: Routes are NOT observed; targets are never relabelled as routes. No proxy is consumed for snaps or routes.

sampling_unit: A player-game row exists only when the player recorded a pass attempt, target or carry (the incumbent player_week definition). Games with no recorded opportunity are MISSING, not zero, in every arm (recorded zeros such as an RB with carries and 0 targets are real zeros). This is a known selection limitation shared by all arms and by the evaluation universe.

opportunity.target_share: targets / team pass attempts (WR, TE, RB)

estimator.historical_prior: Season S-1 ratio estimate for the player (all S-1 games, any team), shrunk toward the S-1 position population mean with k0 (between-player method of moments). No S-1 games -> prior = position mean of first-appearance player-seasons in training ('no_prior'). Team volume prior = S-1 team per-game mean shrunk toward league mean. Labelled historical prior, never 'pre-season projection'.
estimator.current: Season-S ratio estimate from games on the CURRENT team strictly before the target week (sum numerator / sum denominator). Same-season games for another team are counted and reported but not used.
estimator.posterior: post = (D_cur * r_cur + k * prior) / (D_cur + k); weight on current w = D_cur / (D_cur + k), D_cur = current-season denominator (team attempts for shares, player opportunities for efficiency, games for team volume).
estimator.k_estimation: k = phi / rho. phi = game-cluster-robust sampling dispersion: sum_g (y_g - r*d_g)^2 / sum_g d_g / g(r) pooled over training player-seasons (games are the independent unit; plays inside a game are not). rho = mean over training player-seasons of [(r_season - prior)^2 - phi*g(prior)/D_season] / g(prior), floored at 1e-6. g(p) = p(1-p) for proportions (shares, catch rate), p^2 for positive rates (ypt, ypc, ypa), 1 for team volume. Estimated per quantity x position x regime, regime in {same_team, team_changed, no_prior}; cells with < 30 player-seasons pool across regimes. k clipped to [1e-3, 1e5].
estimator.fit_seasons: For target season S, k/phi/rho/k0 use only season pairs (S'-1 -> S') with S' < S. Nothing from season S or later is read.
estimator.conservation: Per team and target week, if the sum of posterior shares over supplied players exceeds 1, shares are scaled proportionally to sum 1 and the factor recorded; otherwise the unallocated remainder is reported. Absent-player reallocation stays with nflvalue.availability.reallocate_usage (not duplicated here).

arms.INC: deployed incumbent: projection.project on player_week roll_* (flat 8-game window across seasons/teams, efficiency shrunk k=6 games) and team_week roll volume, opponent factor for yards markets
arms.PRIOR: opportunity = historical prior only (no season-S games); efficiency = INC efficiency
arms.CURR: opportunity = current-season estimate only (prior used only when no season-S game exists); efficiency = INC efficiency
arms.C: PRIMARY CHALLENGER. opportunity = adaptive posterior; efficiency = INC efficiency (opportunity-first)
arms.C2: secondary: opportunity = adaptive posterior; efficiency = adaptive posterior with its own learned k
arms.EP: descriptive: C opportunity, efficiency = historical prior only
arms.EC: descriptive: C opportunity, efficiency = current-season only

shared_components: Every arm uses the incumbent opponent factor (same row lookup), the same market distribution family and the deployed dispersion_v1 conditional SD a*mean^b (fitted 2023-2024 on incumbent residuals, used unchanged as a shared nuisance). No sportsbook line, spread, total or price enters any arm or any shrinkage target.
universe: player_week rows 2021-2025 REG with finite INC mean for the market: receiving_yards/receptions/targets WR+TE, rushing_yards/rush_attempts RB, passing_yards/pass_attempts QB. Same rows for every arm (rows where any arm is non-finite are dropped from all arms and counted). 2026 W1-2 reported descriptively only.
metrics: CRPS (closed-form normal / sampled for gamma, negbinom with seed 20260922, 400 draws, identical draws across arms)
n rows, n games, n players
uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap resampling whole games (game_id), 1000 reps, seed 20260922.

gate_C_vs_INC.G1: pooled 2021-2025 delta MAE (C - INC) 95% CI upper bound < 0 on all three opportunity endpoints
gate_C_vs_INC.G2: |bias_C| <= |bias_INC| + 0.01 * mean(actual) on every one of the 6 markets and targets
gate_C_vs_INC.G3: delta CRPS point estimate <= 0 on >= 4 of 6 markets and no market with delta CRPS 95% CI lower bound > 0
gate_C_vs_INC.decision: All of G1-G4 -> 'discovery pass: recommend deployed shadow + prospective 2026 W3+ test'. Any failure -> 'deployed shadow / display-only diagnostic'. No outcome here promotes to primary. Gates are not changed after results.

descriptive_only: C vs PRIOR, C vs CURR, C2 vs C, EP, EC
by number of current-season games before target week {0,1,2,3-4,5-8,9+}
subgroup_rule: No subgroup, week bucket or regime is promoted from these results. They answer 'how much weight' descriptively; any subgroup rule needs a new protocol and prospective data.
